prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: which category does each product belong to, and when did it launch? From the products table, return three columns, in this order: product_name, category_id, launch_date. Return one row per product and keep every product. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, count the columns the query returns and compare them with the three the question asks for.

Look at the headings of the result: the product names sit under the heading category_id. Two column names in the SELECT list need a separator between them; without it, the second name becomes a new name for the first column.
starter_sql:
SELECT product_name category_id, launch_date
FROM products
why_this_works: A comma separates every two columns in the SELECT list. Without it, category_id became a new name for product_name, and one column was lost.
